ns2:section.sectionText: Please note: Pre-reqs that will be enforced this semester are: JOUR 340 or JOUR 480 KRE TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 34913 or FA 71504) or JOUR 199 TVP TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 64995 or FA 51646). An additional note: JOUR 317 is repeatable once. However, JOUR 480 KRE TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 34913 or FA 71504) and JOUR 199 TVP TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 64995 or FA 51646) are both equivalent to this course. Students can only receive credit twice for any combination of JOUR 317, JOUR 199 TVP and JOUR 480 KRE. *Students must register for the Lecture and one Discussion/Lab section.
